method: offset-decoy: peak presence at a compound's real adduct m/z vs nulls; anchor-swap is the fair null
adduct_panel: the 5 mechanisms actually assigned in the demo (verified vs ionization_mechanism table): pos [M+H]+/[M+NH4]+/[M+CH4N2O+H]+, neg [M-H]-/[M+Br]-. Earlier runs wrongly included [M+HBrBr]- (not a real mechanism) and [M+CO3]- (defined but never assigned).
ratios: lr = p_real / p_swap, the likelihood ratio; log_lr is the corroboration weight. odds_ratio = odds(p_real) / odds(p_swap) is what this record first named lr and the shipped weights were read off (#3161); the by-polarity rates were not recorded, so only their odds ratios remain.
recommendation: fold as additive per-adduct log likelihood ratios on logit(p_correct), capped (<=+3) and shrunk; weights are instrument/library-specific -> calibration store (D6); monoisotopic-only => conservative lower bound
caveats: weights encode Br/Ur reagent chemistry; do not hardcode universally
'present' is monoisotopic-only, so LRs are a conservative lower bound vs a fit-gated corroboration
anchor-swap pool includes real primaries -> also conservative

[M+Br2]-/[M+Br3]-/[M+NO3]-/[M+CO3]- are defined in the library but not assigned in this dataset; if the target collection lacks ion rows for them they'd be untapped corroboration channels (unverified)
